steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld fighting game, same art style as the FIRST attached sprite sheet (use it ONLY for the grid layout, size and style, NOT for the character). The SECOND attached image shows the HU ANH (the dark smoke spirit) only for its LOOK: colours, smoke, eyes, tentacles, crystal shards. Flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no grid lines). One character per cell, centered, same size in every cell, feet (smoke base) on the same line, sprites must not touch each other or the cell edges. Character: HU ANH AVATAR, the final boss: a dark purple-black SMOKE BEAST the size of a big wolf, made entirely of thick swirling shadow smoke, no fur, no scales, no real animal. Two glowing white-violet slanted eyes, a glowing crack for a mouth, 4-6 smoke tentacles flowing from the back and shoulders, wispy smoke base instead of clear feet. Five thin glowing cracks across its body in five colours: red, silver-white, green, blue, earth-gold. Small floating violet crystal shards around it. Menacing but readable at small size, strong dark outline. Canvas 1254x1254, grid 4 columns x 4 rows, every frame FACING DOWN (toward the viewer). Row 1: fighting stance breathing, 4 frames. Row 2: gliding run, 4 frames. Row 3: claw wind-up, claw slash, recover, smoke dash. Row 4: charging (smoke gathering), casting (arms/tentacles thrust forward), hit (recoil, smoke scattering), stunned (eyes dim, swirls).
